description: This file defines the LayoutForm class for configuring navigation blocks within Drupal, including form building, submission handling, and visibility toggling of form elements.

classes.name: LayoutForm
classes.description: A final class extending FormBase, responsible for rendering and processing a form to configure navigation block layouts in Drupal.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: enableEditMode
methods.description: Handles switching the form into edit mode, toggling visibility of form elements.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the navigation layout form with sections, actions, and attached libraries.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, triggering save if 'save' button is pressed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the section storage and logs a message indicating navigation blocks are saved.

methods.name: handleFormElementsVisibility
methods.description: Controls visibility of form elements based on whether edit mode is enabled.
